lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. Spot size increases and density decreases along the longitudinal axis towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows to create a semi-regular grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance peaks to shadowed troughs.
